task_completion.description: The Zotero application is open and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Zotero 7 window is visible, showing the library interface with items like 'Deep Learning' or 'Attention is All You Need'.

task_completion.description: The tag selector pane or the 'Tags' tab in the item details pane is visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The bottom-left tag pane is visible or the 'Tags' tab is selected in the right-hand sidebar.

task_completion.description: At least one distinct tag based on research topics has been created and applied to an item.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A specific tag (e.g., 'Computer Vision', 'NLP') appears in the tag list or under the 'Tags' tab for a selected item.

task_completion.description: A second distinct tag based on research topics has been created and applied.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second unique tag name is visible in the library's tag cloud or assigned to an item.

task_completion.description: A third distinct tag based on research topics has been created and applied, meeting the minimum requirement of three.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A third unique tag name is visible. The tag selector pane should now show at least three distinct user-created tags.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI to add tags rather than background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor interacting with the 'Tags' tab, the 'Add' button, or right-clicking items to manage tags.

integrity.description: The tags created are actually relevant to the research topics of the papers.
integrity.visual_evidence: Tag names correspond to the content of the papers (e.g., 'GANs' for Goodfellow, 'Transformers' for Vaswani) rather than random strings.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to manipulate the Zotero SQLite database directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not used for sqlite3 commands or python scripts that bypass the UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Zotero library contains 8 machine learning papers (LeCun, Krizhevsky, Goodfellow, Vaswani, Silver, Brown, Devlin, He). The agent must create at least 3 distinct tags. Common relevant tags would be 'Deep Learning', 'Computer Vision', 'NLP', or 'Reinforcement Learning'. Zotero version is 7.0.11. Tags can be verified in the bottom-left 'Tag Selector' pane or the 'Tags' tab in the right-hand item metadata pane.
